dedupe_keys.name: global reservoir sedimentation rate grsr dataset

description: The Global Reservoir Sedimentation Rate (GRSR) dataset estimates the annual sediment volume and the reservoir sedimentation rate, meaning annual sediment volume divided by initial storage capacity, for 34,372 reservoirs worldwide. The estimates come from the Integrated Reservoir Sedimentation Prediction framework, which applies machine learning to climatic, geomorphic, hydrological and reservoir predictors, and each value carries a standard deviation across spatial cross-validation folds. Every reservoir is linked to the Global Dam Watch v1.0 database by its identifier. It was produced by a team at Southwest University and published on Zenodo in September 2026 as a 1.7 MB XLSX file under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the rates are model predictions, not surveys, uncertainty is large for poorly observed regions, and management such as flushing is not represented. Simulation uses: projecting storage loss for reservoir capacity planning and climate adaptation. Related record: Global Dam Watch (data-global-dam-watch-database).
name: Global Reservoir Sedimentation Rate (GRSR) dataset
notes: The caveat on flushing is an inference, not from the record.
schema_summary: per reservoir: GDW identifier, predicted annual sediment volume, its standard deviation across spatial cross-validation folds, reservoir sedimentation rate (annual sediment volume over initial storage)
